text: Learning a new skill is an exciting journey that requires both practice and patience. You will not become an expert overnight, so it is important to accept mistakes as part of the process. Begin by gathering good resources, such as online courses, books, or a mentor, to guide your early steps. To stay motivated, track your progress regularly—write down what you have mastered or record short videos of your attempts. Small, visible improvements will encourage you to continue even when things get tough. Remember, the key is to keep going: a little practice every day beats a long session once a month.
